preconditions.description: The number of numbers n is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: Each number in the list is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(all(abs(numbers[i] - numbers[(i + 1) % n]) == 1 for i in range(n)) for numbers in permutations(numbers)) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a permutation of the numbers where each pair of neighboring numbers differs by exactly 1, otherwise 'NO'.
